generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; never NULL; unique.
generic_sampling_rules.real_pk: Sequential integers cast to REAL starting at 1.0; never NULL; unique.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy an existing parent primary-key value (cast to INT when the parent PK is REAL); never NULL when the column is NOT NULL; may be NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Draw from a small pool of realistic names/labels; allow near-duplicates (case/whitespace variants) and occasional NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: Draw from a pool of sentence-like notes; allow near-duplicates and occasional NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_measure: Uniform real in the observed min..max range, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.int_measure: Uniform integer in the observed min..max range; NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.date_text: Format 'DD Mon YYYY'; sample uniformly between 2000-01-01 and 2020-12-31; NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_rule: For each numeric column with listed literals, plant values at literal-1, literal, literal+1 into the generated rows (post-processing injection), respecting NOT NULL and type.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_rule: For ORDER columns, ensure at least two rows share the value at the listed rank when the rank is reachable at the chosen table size; otherwise record as not applicable.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_rule: For DISTINCT columns, ensure 20-50% of rows share values with another row (best-effort at small table sizes).
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: For every nullable column, include at least one NULL row; NULL share follows the compact database share (0% observed, so use 5-10% to exercise NULL paths). NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL.

uncertainty: Range/positivity rules (Making_Year, value_points, quality_rank, Age, Starting_Year) are inferred from only 8 sample rows and are treated as SOFT (not hard-enforced by samplers); they are recorded for reference. Observed NULL rates are 0% for all columns; NULL shares for all nullable columns (technician.Team, technician.Name, machine.Machine_series, machine.Class, machine.Team, repair.Notes) are set to 5-30% per atomic-operation targets rather than observed data, and require explicit NULL injection. The 5-30% NULL bands for columns without atomic-operation evidence (technician.Name, machine.Class, machine.Team, repair.Notes) are best-effort/uncertain; the interface NULL rule (at least one NULL per nullable column, share following compact share) governs them. Ties at ranks 100/1000/100000 are unreachable at the fixed 8-row table sizes and are marked not applicable. Group-size and duplicate-share targets are best-effort at 8 rows. Boundary literals (35,36,37,38 for Age; 70 for value_points) require a post-processing injection step. Table sizes are fixed at 8 per table and must be honored by the generator (not overridden by random size selection). The group_sizes target on technician.technician_id is not satisfiable because it is a primary key (unique by construction); it is retained only as a reference and should be treated as not applicable. FK type compatibility: technician.technician_id is REAL while repair_assignment.technician_id is INT; FK values must be cast to INT when copied. Literal-pool keys are flat 'table.col' strings (e.g. 'machine.value_points'); the loader must split on '.' rather than unpack tuples.
